title: All the rows: a full GEMM
starter:
%A   = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=0
%B   = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=1
%C   = buffer 4 dtype=i32 slot=2
%j   = range 2
%cv  = shrink %C %j []
%z   = store %cv 0
%C0  = after %C %z
%k   = range 3
%av  = shrink %A %k []
%x   = load %av
%k2  = mul %k 2
%kj  = add %k2 %j
%bv  = shrink %B %kj []
%y   = load %bv
%p   = mul %x %y
%cv0 = shrink %C0 %j []
%cur = load %cv0
%sum = add %cur %p
%s   = store %cv0 %sum
%ek  = end %s %k
%ej  = end %ek %j
%C1  = after %C %ej
hints: The starter is the row program with A's row 0. You need one more range, and two indexes have to start using it.
Add `%i = range 2`. A's element is at `i*3 + k` and C's element is at `i*2 + j`. Use the C offset for both the reset view and the view on `%C0`.

Build `%i3 = mul %i 3`, `%ik = add %i3 %k` for A, and `%i2 = mul %i 2`, `%ij = add %i2 %j` for C. Then close three loops: `%ek = end %s %k`, `%ej = end %ek %j`, `%ei = end %ej %i`, and finish with `%C1 = after %C %ei`.
explain: Three ranges: `i` picks the row of A, `j` picks the column of B, `k` walks along both. A is read at `i*3 + k`, B at `k*2 + j`, and the sum for one cell is kept in C itself at `i*2 + j`. The reset store depends on `i` and `j` through its offset, so it runs once per cell. The ends close k, then j, then i, which makes k the innermost loop.
